protocol.std: between-seed sample SD, ddof=1; same cohort is not three independent sample sets
protocol.visibility: full: every direct modified line complete; partial: some Diff Token visible but not all lines complete; invisible: nonempty original Diff with no visible Diff Tokens; no_direct_diff: empty original Diff
protocol.encoding: formal RobertaTokenizerFast(trim_offsets=False), no prefix/additional special tokens; first510 source BPE Tokens plus CLS/SEP, pad to512; whitespace consumes budget but has no pooling mass; comments remain source; physical line IDs zero-based
protocol.token_mass: bounded_pool reciprocal cross-line membership; only foreground>0 AND background>0 contributes region loss; partial final lines retained by historical PrimeVul rule
protocol.supervision: Train actual; Valid/Test counterfactual availability only, never supplied to inference
